
 ▐▛███▛█   Claude Code v2.1.327
▝▜██████▀  Opus 5.5 · API Usage Billing
  ~/devel/dasio

▎ Auto mode is now Claude Code's default permission mode.
▎ Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically. Claude checks each tool call for
▎ risky actions and prompt injection before executing, runs the ones it assesses as lower-risk, and
▎ blocks the rest.
▎ https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes

  counted, never blocks 🏁 (paste `core-quals --waiting`/`--ops-wait`). NEVER bury a question or
  blame my silence. No night/day difference (#791): work the backlog and ask questions 24/7 — no
  night-hour cutoff, no time-of-day deferral. Bounce lane: open tickets labeled prio:bounce jump
  the queue, oldest-first (never preempting running work); a named nudge gets a one-line ACK +
  prio:bounce label, taken next turn, never worked inline. Count a ticket done ONLY after
  verifying from primary sources — `gh pr view` (merged, closingIssuesReferences), `gh run list`
  (main green), `gh issue view` (closed), the deployed version on the live target — never the
  worker's claim alone; verify the LAST ticket as strictly as the first. After EVERY integration

  `✅ DONE:` — CONTINUE, NEVER satisfies (B). Machine compacts are REMOVED (#1084) — native
